messages:
Priya N.: Quick thread 8: drafting the v0.9.4 changelog bullets. Top items: routing policy tweak (clarify canary behavior), quantization note fix in the runtime docs, and embedding streaming deprecation + migration examples. PRs: #5234 (changelog), #5241 (snippet updates), #5250 (redirects). Need a quick pass for clarity + link sanity.
Ethan K.: I can look at the routing blurb and the canary wording. Prefer passive voice? keep it short.
Rosa M.: I grabbed #5241 52 and noticed the ruby example still shows old 'generate' call. I'll update to `Responses.create` style and add a short migration tip.
Priya N.: Please make the migration tip a single line under "Known issues" with a link to the full guide. We want <=1 sentence per bullet.
docs-bot: Note: docs merge freeze ends at 08:00 UTC tomorrow. Any changelog PRs must be merged by 06:30 UTC.
Ethan K.: For routing: proposed bullet: "Smart routing defaults updated; canary requests may route to fallback models until cache warmed. See guide." Short and factual. Thoughts?
Rosa M.: That reads fine. I'll add a parenthetical about latency spikes during warm-up.
Priya N.: Good. On embeddings migration: instead of streaming, recommend batch `embeddings.create()` + async polling for long jobs. Add short code hint: JS: `const job = await client.embeddings.create({input: batch}); // poll job.status`
Ethan K.: Can we also note token counting difference with quantized models? One-line: "Quantized model token accounting corrected; regenerate cost estimates if you rely on per-token billing."
Rosa M.: Pinged #5241 with a tiny fix: update ruby + python examples and add a one-line migration note for `stream`->`poll`.
Priya N.: Thanks. Oliver, can you run link-check? (wait wrong channel) Oliver not here 52 who can run link-check?
Ethan K.: I can run link-checker after PRs merge and post results.
ci-bot: CI: PR #5250 redirect-mr shows broken link test failing on /guides/auth -> fixed anchor mismatch.
Rosa M.: I'll patch the anchor in the redirect MR.
Priya N.: Final checklist before merge: 1) #5241 snippet fixes (Rosa) 2) #5234 changelog copy (Ethan) 3) #5250 redirects (Rosa) 4) post-merge link-check (Ethan). Merge window cutoff 06:30 UTC.
Rosa M.: #5241 merged (tiny edits).
Ethan K.: #5234 updated and ready; added the two short bullets.
ci-bot: CI: #5250 all checks green.
Rosa M.: Redirect MR merged.
Priya N.: All merged. I'll queue the changelog for publish. If anything looks off after deploy, call a quick revert with "docs-revert" in this channel. Thanks team! :rocket:
